name: the-protectors
description: Autonomous, evidence-based security review and hardening for any project.

interface.shortDescription: Secure, audit and harden any project with verified findings.
interface.longDescription: Recon, 135 tested scanner rules, git-history secrets, dependency audit with OSV + CISA KEV + EPSS and a CycloneDX SBOM, file-by-file review under an evidence contract (confirmed / needs validation / rejected) with a coverage ledger, platform-specific defenses and a verified report.
defaultPrompt: Protect this project: full security verification and hardening.
Audit our dependencies and produce an SBOM.
Check this repository and its git history for leaked secrets.
